captions.ig:
Most happy customers never leave a review because nobody asked. Here are 5 Claude prompts to ask every customer, the honest way.

1. Ask right after the job, with one real detail and your link.
2. Ask everyone the same way, not only the happy ones.
3. A short thank you card with your review QR code.
4. Reply to a 5 star in 2 personal sentences.
5. Answer a 1 star calmly, in public, with a way to fix it.

Rule of thumb: Google does not allow freebies or discounts in exchange for reviews.

Comment AGENTS and we will DM you the free Front Desk Starter: replies to customers in your voice. It drafts, you send.

Sources: Google Business Profile Help, BrightLocal, ReviewTrackers, FTC.

#smallbusiness #googlereviews #claudeai #customerservice #smallbusinessowner
